description: Canonical intervention registry for the TX Dashboard Core. It records approved, human-owned follow-through and learning; it does not execute customer outreach, configuration changes, data pulls or product work.

record_contract.entry_gate: A linked System Request must be explicitly APPROVED in system_request_review.json. For a play/lead intervention, the lead/play must also be approved for operational use.
record_contract.authority_rule: A record is accountability and learning state only. Every external action retains its own authorization gate.
